The dispatch tests retain exact task and Executor-profile bindings, require a fresh dispatch after terminal rejection, and assert that reconciliation creates no RUN. Successful chain reconciliation supplies the bounded PROVEN_REPAIR_CHAIN_RECOVERABLE diagnostic.

The candidate includes real-Git RUN-414 positive and adversarial lineage tests. The sole failing restart test double now accepts the optional diagnostic argument while retaining its durable-dispatch, restart and profile assertions. The edited file passed syntax and whitespace checks.
